messages.subject: Problems with custom theme
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone a clue why I get this error message and how to solve it?

Error in element_grob.element_text(el, ...) : 
  Text element requires non-NULL value for 'angle'.

THANKS!
Stefan

Please see below for details and code:

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.15.2 (2012-10-26)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252  LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                          
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] ggplot2_0.9.3

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] colorspace_1.2-1   dichromat_2.0-0    digest_0.6.3       grid_2.15.2       
 [5] gtable_0.1.2       labeling_0.1       MASS_7.3-22        munsell_0.4       
 [9] plyr_1.8           proto_0.3-10       RColorBrewer_1.0-5 reshape2_1.2.2    
[13] scales_0.2.3       stringr_0.6.2      tools_2.15.2


require(ggplot2)

windowsFonts(TNR=windowsFont("Times New Roman"))

theme_fig <- function(base_size = 10){
  modifyList(theme_bw(base_size, base_family = "TNR"),
             list(legend.title = element_blank(),
             legend.key =   element_blank(),
             axis.text.x =  element_text(size=9),
             axis.text.y =  element_text(size=9),
             axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0,size=11),    
             axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust=0.5,size=11),
             plot.title =   element_text(face='bold',size=14,hjust=0)))
}

df <- data.frame(XX=c(1:10),YY=c(rnorm(10)))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=XX, y=YY)) + geom_point() + theme_fig()
p

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Problems with custom theme
parts:
Hi Stephan,

I think the modifyList approach is not the best way in recent versions. Try

legend.key =   element_blank(),
             axis.text.x =  element_text(size=9),
             axis.text.y =  element_text(size=9),
             axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0,size=11),
             axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust=0.5,size=11),
             plot.title =   element_text(face='bold',size=14,hjust=0))
}
